description: INSERT OR IGNORE against a duplicate primary key value must be silently skipped -- exactly PostgreSQL's ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING semantics, which is what Rewrite translates it to -- so the original row's value survives untouched

body: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tC{{DLID}} (id, name) VALUES (1, 'dup')
SELECT name FROM tC{{DLID}} WHERE id = 1

tests.name: duplicate insert was silently ignored; original value survives
